questions.question: Paper claim Theorem 3.1 (thm:gaps) states: “For all $n\ge2$, $p_{n+1}-p_n\ge2$ and $p_{n+1}-p_n$ is even. Consequently $H_1\ge2$, and $H_1\le3$ if and only if $p_{n+1}-p_n=2$ for infinitely many $n$.”. Lean theorem `two_le_gap` assumes `1 ≤ n` (n ≥ 1), but the claim says n ≥ 2. Is this an intentional indexing convention or a genuine change of domain?
